bugs.title: Cleanup deleted ALL jobs, not a small/unlucky subset - series_is_complete() ignores the is_final flag, wiping mid-series jobs
bugs.notes: ROOT CAUSE RE-VERIFIED against current repo (not trusted blindly): cleanup commit 1d6ad63 (2026-08-29 21:43:52 UTC per its commit timestamp 1788027832) deleted jobs manual-1787970449255, manual-1787978239962, series-1787970477573-p2; their status.json at parent dce3b5f shows expires_at_epoch genuinely past (10581s/3368s/7475s respectively) and publishing.status=scheduled with post times after deletion — active, unfinished work. Defect confirmed in code: read_job_timing() extracted series_final but series_is_complete() never consumed it; a series whose existing parts were all terminal counted complete with ZERO is_final parts. Sibling comparison confirmed: series-1787978275321-p2 (is_final:true) still on disk — its p1 reap was legitimate; series-1787970477573 had p1+p2 both is_final:false (part 3 never rendered) — both wrongfully wiped. FIX (commit e81ac72): series_is_complete() now requires (a) every on-disk part terminal (unchanged bug-49 rule: non-terminal/unreadable sibling still protects) AND (b) >=1 part marked is_final; zero-final series = incomplete. No other behavior in expired.py touched (expiry fallback chain, 3-phase main, release/branch handling intact). TESTS: fixed 3 stale JobTiming assertions to current return shape (series_id/series_final), added test_reads_series_fields + 4 bug-66 regression cases incl. full mocked end-to-end replay of the incident (mid-series protected; final-marked series still reaped). test_cleanup.py 26/26 pass; full pipeline suite 305 passed with only the 10 pre-existing unrelated failures (test_stage_a x2, test_stage_b x7, test_status x1) that fail identically on unmodified main — zero new failures. RECOVERY (commit 0e2f9d7, done AFTER the fix was verifiably live on origin/main): restored all 16 files of the 3 job folders byte-identical from parent commit dce3b5f, unmodified — no TTL extensions; jobs whose expires_at_epoch has since genuinely passed will expire normally under the fixed logic. PERMANENTLY LOST (honest scope): all three jobs had reached state=complete with rendered assets — their GitHub Releases, final.mp4 / final.zip assets, clipforge-<job-id> git tags, and per-job branches were destroyed via irreversible GitHub API DELETE calls in the 1d6ad63 run and CANNOT be recovered by any means; all three require a full re-render to get the finished videos back. Restored metadata (stage-a-request, production plan, ingest, torrent-selection, status incl. scheduled post details) tells the operator exactly what to re-render. PUSH VERIFIED: all session commits confirmed on origin/main via git fetch + git log origin/main (0a7dcd1 seed/push-test, aab8c4c in_progress, e81ac72 fix, 0e2f9d7 recovery, plus this final state update).

bugs.title: scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs reclaims an active, non-final series part's label the moment its own status goes terminal, because the terminal-state check runs BEFORE the series-incomplete check (classify() ordering bug; seriesIncomplete() never reached for terminal parts)
bugs.notes: Seeded 2026-08-29. Prior sweep (bug-66) was sweep_complete; this seed starts a new sweep per contract while preserving bug-66 history. Real incident confirmed in prompt: job manual-1788023189426, state=complete, series.enabled=true, series_id=series-1788023208180, part=1, is_final=false, expires_at_epoch 1788070049 (genuinely future). /tasks showed 'No tasks yet' — label reclaimed while job alive. ROOT CAUSE (to re-verify against current code, not blindly trusted): classify() in scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs returns `stale:terminal-<state>` for complete/error/cancelled BEFORE evaluating the bug-49 series-protection branch, making that protection unreachable dead code for terminal series parts. FIX PLAN: (1) reorder classify() so an enabled, incomplete-series membership protects before the terminal short-circuit; (2) audit this script's seriesIncomplete() against pipeline/cleanup/expired.py's series_is_complete() post-bug-66 (must require a terminal is_final part to count a series complete) and align if it has the same gap. VERIFY: unit-test the exact incident data shape (state=complete, enabled series, is_final=false, no sibling) -> expect 'active'; finished series (terminal is_final sibling + this part terminal) -> stale; non-series terminal -> stale (no regression); add/extend test coverage for classify()/seriesIncomplete() if none exists; run script's dry-run mode per its header comment as a real-world sanity check if credentials permit.
